Name: DC Lantern Rings
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#00FF00]DC Lantern Rings[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4]Bring the emotional spectrum to Stardew Valley! This mod adds the [b]7 Lantern Corps rings[/b] from DC Comics, each with unique passive effects, an active ability (press [b]R[/b]), thematic pair synergies, and its own lore-friendly acquisition method.[/size]

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]7 unique rings[/b] — one for each Lantern Corps[/*]
[*][b]Passive effects[/b] while equipped[/*]
[*][b]Active abilities[/b] — press [b]R[/b] to unleash your ring's power[/*]
[*][b]Pair synergies[/b] — equip two compatible rings for bonus effects[/*]
[*][b]Thematic acquisition[/b] — each ring has its own unique way to be obtained[/*]
[*][b]Full translations[/b] — English, Spanish and Chinese[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]💍 [color=#00FF00]Green Lantern Ring[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Passive: [b]+5% Damage[/b][/*]
[*]Active (R): [b]Shield of Will[/b] — grants 5 seconds of invincibility with a green halo shield[/*]
[*]Synergy: [i]Spectrum of Hope[/i] with the Blue Ring ([b]+8 Defense, +3 Speed[/b])[/*]
[*]How to get: event on your farm after reaching [b]Combat level 5[/b][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]💍 [color=#0080FF]Blue Lantern Ring[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Passive: [b]+3 Luck[/b][/*]
[*]Active (R): [b]Ray of Hope[/b] — lightning AoE that damages nearby enemies and heals you for 50% of your max HP[/*]
[*]Synergy: [i]Spectrum of Hope[/i] with the Green Ring ([b]+8 Defense, +3 Speed[/b])[/*]
[*]How to get: [b]5% chance[/b] from fishing treasure chests at the Beach[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]💍 [color=#FF0000]Red Lantern Ring[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Passive: [b]+10% Damage[/b], [b]-4 Defense[/b][/*]
[*]Active (R): [b]Rage Burst[/b] — explosion around the player + temporary +10% damage buff[/*]
[*]Synergy: [i]Serene Rage[/i] with the Indigo Ring ([b]+4 Defense, +5% Damage[/b])[/*]
[*]How to get: [b]2% drop[/b] from Shadow Shamans[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]💍 [color=#FFFF00]Yellow Lantern Ring[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Passive: [b]+8 Defense[/b][/*]
[*]Active (R): [b]Aura of Terror[/b] — continuously damages enemies within a 4-tile radius for 5 seconds[/*]
[*]Synergy: [i]Bond of Terror[/i] with the Violet Ring ([b]+5% Crit, +3 Defense[/b])[/*]
[*]How to get: open the [b]treasure chest on Mine floor 100[/b][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]💍 [color=#FF1493]Violet Lantern Ring[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Passive: [b]+96 Magnetism[/b], [b]+2 Luck[/b][/*]
[*]Active (R): [b]Arrow of Love[/b] — fires a magic projectile in the direction you're facing[/*]
[*]Synergy: [i]Bond of Terror[/i] with the Yellow Ring ([b]+5% Crit, +3 Defense[/b])[/*]
[*]How to get: [b]gift from your spouse[/b] the morning after your wedding[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]💍 [color=#FF8000]Orange Lantern Ring[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Passive: [b]+2 Luck[/b], [b]+3 Mining[/b][/*]
[*]Active (R): [b]Gold Fever[/b] — 30% extra gold drops from monsters for 15 seconds[/*]
[*]Synergy: [i]None[/i] — the Orange light serves only itself[/*]
[*]How to get: [b]buy from Clint[/b] at the Blacksmith for 50,000g[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]💍 [color=#8000FF]Indigo Lantern Ring[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Passive: [b]+3 Foraging[/b], [b]+3 Fishing[/b][/*]
[*]Active (R): [b]Compassionate Blessing[/b] — restores 50% of your max stamina[/*]
[*]Synergy: [i]Serene Rage[/i] with the Red Ring ([b]+4 Defense, +5% Damage[/b])[/*]
[*]How to get: reach [b]10 hearts with Krobus[/b] and then enter the Sewers[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🔗 Synergies[/b][/size]
Equip two compatible rings at the same time to unlock bonus effects:

[list]
[*][color=#00FF00]Green[/color] + [color=#0080FF]Blue[/color] → [b]Spectrum of Hope[/b] ([i]+8 Defense, +3 Speed[/i])[/*]
[*][color=#FF0000]Red[/color] + [color=#8000FF]Indigo[/color] → [b]Serene Rage[/b] ([i]+4 Defense, +5% Damage[/i])[/*]
[*][color=#FFFF00]Yellow[/color] + [color=#FF1493]Violet[/color] → [b]Bond of Terror[/b] ([i]+5% Crit, +3 Defense[/i])[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🔍 Spoiler: How to Get Each Ring[/b][/size]
[i]If you want to discover each ring on your own, skip this section. If you're stuck, open the spoilers below.[/i]

[size=4][color=#00FF00][b]🟢 Green Lantern Ring[/b][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reach [b]Combat level 5[/b][/*]
[*]Wait for a [b]clear night[/b] (not raining, not snowing)[/*]
[*]Go to your farm between [b]21:00 and 02:00[/b][/*]
[/list][b]What happens:[/b]
A cinematic event triggers automatically. A mysterious voice (the ring itself) scans you and offers you the Green Lantern oath. Once you accept, the ring is added to your inventory.
[list]
[*]Event only triggers [b]once[/b][/*]
[*]If you miss it, walk around your farm at the right time[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#0080FF][b]🔵 Blue Lantern Ring [/b][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Have access to the [b]Beach[/b][/*]
[*]Have a [b]fishing rod[/b][/*]
[*]Have at least [b]Fishing level 2[/b] (to reliably catch treasure chests)[/*]
[/list][b]What happens:[/b]
While fishing at the Beach, you may pull up a [b]treasure chest[/b]. There's a [b]5% chance[/b] the Blue Ring will be inside.
[list]
[*]Only works at the [b]Beach[/b] (not the Mountain Lake, Forest, etc.)[/*]
[*]If you don't see it after many chests, keep trying — it's random[/*]
[*]Higher luck (from food, rings, or the day's Fortune Teller) improves your odds of getting chests[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#FF0000][b]🔴 Red Lantern Ring [/b][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reach the [b]lower Mine floors[/b] (around floor 80+) or the [b]Skull Cavern[/b][/*]
[*]Bring good weapons and defense[/*]
[/list][b]What happens:[/b]
Shadow Shamans (the red-robed shadow enemies) have a [b]2% chance Pegar[/b] to drop the Red Ring when defeated.
[list]
[*]Drop chance is [b]per kill[/b], not per day[/*]
[*]Use the [b]Burglar's Ring[/b] to double your drop chances[/*]
[*]Eat food with [b]+Luck[/b] to improve the odds slightly[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#FFFF00][b]🟡 Yellow Lantern Ring [/b][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reach [b]Mine floor 100[/b][/*]
[*]Have a decent weapon and healing items[/*]
[/list][b]What happens:[/b]
When you first enter [b]floor 100[/b] of the Mines, a gift chest appears [b]2 tiles to your right[/b]. Open it to claim the Yellow Ring.
[list]
[*]The chest spawns [b]only once per save file[/b][/*]
[*]If you already received the ring, the chest won't appear again[/*]
[*]If the tile to your right is blocked, restart the game and try again from a different entrance tile[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#FF1493][b]🟣 Violet Lantern Ring [/b][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Be [b]married[/b] (or have Krobus as a roommate)[/*]
[*]Sleep through the night after the wedding[/*]
[/list][b]What happens:[/b]
The morning after your wedding, you'll wake up and your spouse will give you the Violet Ring as a symbol of your bond. A short dialogue plays automatically.
[list]
[*]If you're already married when installing the mod, you'll get the ring the [b]next morning[/b] after sleeping[/*]
[*]Only happens [b]once[/b][/*]
[*]Works with any marriage candidate, including Krobus as a roommate[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#FF8000][b]🟠 Orange Lantern Ring [/b][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Have [b]50,000 gold[/b][/*]
[*]Visit [b]Clint's Blacksmith shop[/b] in Pelican Town[/*]
[/list][b]What happens:[/b]
The Orange Ring appears for sale in Clint's shop for [b]50,000g[/b]. Once purchased, it's yours.
[list]
[*]The ring is [b]always available[/b] after installing the mod[/*]
[*]Only [b]1 in stock[/b] per save[/*]
[*]After buying, a short warning event may trigger the next time you enter the shop — Clint has something to say about the ring's power[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][color=#8000FF][b]🔵 Indigo Lantern Ring [/b][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Have the [b]Rusty Key[/b] (obtained from Gunther after donating 60 items to the Museum)[/*]
[*]Reach [b]10 hearts with Krobus[/b][/*]
[*]Enter the [b]Sewers[/b][/*]
[/list][b]What happens:[/b]
Once you have 10 hearts with Krobus, the next time you enter the Sewers, a cinematic event triggers. Krobus appears and gives you the Indigo Ring as a symbol of compassion towards monsters.
[list]
[*]Only triggers [b]once[/b][/*]
[*]If Krobus has moved in as your roommate, the event will not trigger — he must still be living in the Sewers[/*]
[*]The event triggers automatically when you enter the Sewers from the ladder in Pelican Town[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]

SMAPI 4.0+
Content Patcher
